title: LAYER DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local LAYER direct-codec transaction control across inline, detached, separate, and aliased stream layouts

implementation.behavior: Stage the body, detached string destination, and detached handle destination while preserving the required separate modern string stream, versioned CMC color-book text, legacy typed-null policy, common handles, and plot-style/material/LTYPE references.
